name: bragi
description: Bragi — an AI-native music editor (desktop + web)

scripts.test:all: pnpm test && pnpm test:rust && pnpm test:py
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm schemas:check && pnpm build:wasm && pnpm build:model-wasm && pnpm build:engine-wasm && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm lint:rust && pnpm test:rust && pnpm test:conformance && pnpm lint:py && pnpm test:py
scripts.lint:py: uv run --directory services/workers ruff check . && uv run --directory services/workers ruff format --check . && uv run --directory services/workers mypy .
scripts.lint:all: pnpm lint && pnpm lint:rust && pnpm lint:py
scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p bragi-model -p bragi-dsp -p bragi-engine -p bragi-engine-wasm -p bragi-model-wasm
scripts.eval:analysis:ml: uv run --directory services/workers --extra ml python -m bragi_analysis.evaluation --synthetic
scripts.bench:planner: node scripts/not-yet.mjs bench:planner 2.6 'Planner benchmark (costs API credits)'
